purpose: Test whether failure of a previously confirmed close-based engulfing structure creates short-horizon continuation edge: one side commits, is later invalidated by an opposite-colour close through the Base candle far edge, and entry follows the newly controlling side.

public_logic_sources.source: TradingView — Engulfing Failed Zone [8 Types] / Engulfing Overlap Zone
public_logic_sources.disclosed_logic: Regular Buy engulf = Red Base then next Green close above Base High; Regular Sell mirror. Type-1 additionally sweeps the opposite Base edge before confirmation. Buy engulf fails on first later Red close strictly below Base Low; Sell engulf fails on first later Green close strictly above Base High. Closed bars only.
public_logic_sources.role: Primary exact pattern-confirmation and failure semantics.

public_logic_sources.source: MetaQuotes — How to use MQL5 to detect candlestick patterns
public_logic_sources.disclosed_logic: Closed-candle bullish/bearish engulfing pattern construction and deterministic OHLC pattern detection.
public_logic_sources.role: MetaQuotes corroboration of reconstructible completed-bar engulfing logic.

independence: Entry is generated only by causal failure of a previously confirmed engulfing commitment.

pattern_semantics.regular_buy: Base is Red; immediately following completed bar is Green and closes strictly above Base High.
pattern_semantics.regular_sell: Base is Green; immediately following completed bar is Red and closes strictly below Base Low.
pattern_semantics.type1_buy: Regular Buy plus Confirm-bar Low <= Base Low before/while closing above Base High.
pattern_semantics.type1_sell: Regular Sell plus Confirm-bar High >= Base High before/while closing below Base Low.
pattern_semantics.buy_failure: First later completed Red bar closes strictly below Base Low; trade direction SELL.
pattern_semantics.sell_failure: First later completed Green bar closes strictly above Base High; trade direction BUY.
pattern_semantics.lifecycle: Each confirmed pattern remains active until its first qualifying close-based failure. No retrospective expiry.
pattern_semantics.collision_rule: On one completed bar, collapse multiple same-direction pattern failures to one proposal using the most recently confirmed failed pattern. If both long and short failure directions occur on the same completed bar, emit no ambiguous proposal.

proposal_timing: First executable tick at/after completed failure-bar right edge.

screen_gate.winner_or_quality_gate: official-win delta nonnegative OR positive net with improved gross loss
